fields.name: outcome
docs: Outcome code: 0 = No, 1 = Yes, 2 = Split (50/50), 3 = Refund (per-position cost basis)

fields.name: outcome
docs: Outcome code: 0 = No, 1 = Yes, 2 = Split (50/50), 3 = Refund (per-position cost basis)
Replaces the old `is_yes: bool` — binary compatible (false=0, true=1)

fields.name: settlement_time
docs: Unix timestamp after which claims are permitted

fields.name: claims_enabled
docs: Whether claims are currently enabled for this market

fields.name: outcome
docs: Market outcome: 0 = No, 1 = Yes, 2 = Split, 3 = Refund

fields.name: payout_per_contract_usd
docs: Flat payout per contract in micro-USD (e.g. 1_000_000 for full win, 500_000 for split).
Always 0 for refund outcomes — refund payouts equal `position.total_cost_usd` and are
not a per-contract rate; read `payout_amount` instead.

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of this position

fields.name: market_id
docs: Market ID

fields.name: is_yes
docs: Whether this is a YES or NO position

fields.name: payout_claimed
docs: Whether payout has been claimed (only relevant after market settlement)

fields.name: payout_claimed_usd
docs: Amount claimed in USD with 6 decimals (for record keeping)

fields.name: opened_at
docs: Timestamp when position was opened

fields.name: contracts
docs: Total contracts currently held

fields.name: total_cost_usd
docs: Total cost basis for all contracts (USD with 6 decimals)
This is the sum of all dollars paid for currently held contracts

fields.name: open_orders
docs: Number of open orders for this position

fields.name: fees_paid_usd
docs: Entry fees attached to currently open contracts (USD, 6 decimals).
Reduced proportionally on partial sells; included in realized PnL on exit.

fields.name: realized_pnl_usd
docs: Realized PnL from closed positions (USD, can be negative)

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Timestamp when position was last updated

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump

fields.name: unit_version
docs: Contract unit version. 0 = legacy whole contracts, 1 = micro-contracts.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid to initialize this position account.

fields.name: outcome
docs: Market outcome: 0 = No, 1 = Yes, 2 = Split, 3 = Refund

fields.name: current_open_orders
docs: Legacy unused field retained for account layout compatibility.
Position.open_orders is the maintained source of truth for open orders.
